title: Lecture 3 - Before the Startup (Paul Graham)
summary: Paul Graham's lecture in the 'How to Start a Startup' course, covering counterintuitive parts of startups and how to have ideas. It is the video form of his essay 'Before the Startup'.
why: HN people point to it as the video version of the essay and cite it for advice on building things with interested people before calling it a startup.

quote.text: build things you are interested in with people who are also interested in those things.
